titles:
Welcome to the new(ish) home of Wynne Evans on the radio. 
You can listen via your phone on our apps, here on the site it-self, or via your Alexa. 
I'm so thrilled you found us. I want to get all the Wynners back together, and some are still Missing In Action!! 
There's the usual show plus Musical, Classical & even our own version of  Mindfulness (Wynnefulness) and we even have our very own vicar on a Sunday.   
Brilliant to see you. Come and join the fun & be laughing by lunchtime!! 
Love you, Wynne x
On your phone - search for the Wynne Evans Show in the app store

Click the Enable Skill button in your Amazon / Alexa account and then say 'Open Wynne Evans Show Skill' or 'Launch Wynne Evans Show Skill' 
  Amazon.co.uk: Wynne Evans Show : Alexa Skills
